# CISO.aero

> CISO.aero is a cybersecurity governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platform built for aviation. Consultants and in-house security teams use it to assess airlines, airports, MROs, design and production organisations and their suppliers against EASA Part-IS, TSA, CMMC, NIST and other frameworks, collect evidence once and reuse it across frameworks, and issue reports for leadership.

CISO.aero is a private, sign-in-only web application. The public pages are the home page at https://ciso.aero/ and the demo and pricing request page at https://ciso.aero/demo. Contact: support@ciso.aero.

## What it does

- Control assessments: every requirement is broken into plain-English points of focus that the assessor marks met, not met or not applicable. The result for each control is calculated from those answers, so scoring is consistent between assessors.
- Evidence vault: policies, configuration exports and other evidence are uploaded once per project, attached to the controls they prove, and reused across every framework the client is held to.
- Framework mappings: controls are mapped between frameworks, so work done for one assessment carries into the next.
- Reports: results, gap analysis, statement of applicability, remediation plan and executive summary, generated from the live assessment and downloadable as PDF, Word or Excel.
- Client portal: each organization being assessed gets its own portal and sees only its own data.
- Security: role-based access, account lockout and password-age policies per organization, one-way password hashing, encrypted connections and logged administrative access.

## Who it is for

- Aviation cybersecurity consultants running assessments for multiple clients
- CISOs and compliance teams at airlines, airports, maintenance (MRO), design and production organisations
- Aviation suppliers that must show compliance to their customers

## Frameworks supported

- EASA Part-IS (Commission Regulations (EU) 2022/1645 and 2023/203)
- TSA aviation cybersecurity requirements
- CMMC 2.0
- NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
- NIST SP 800-171
- NIST SP 800-53
- ISO/IEC 27001
- SOC 2
- PCI DSS 4.0.1
- FedRAMP
- HIPAA Security Rule
- NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500
- FTC Safeguards Rule

## How an engagement runs

1. Set up the client: create the project, choose the frameworks that apply, and invite the client's team to their portal.
2. Assess and collect evidence: work through each control, mark its points of focus, and attach evidence from the vault.
3. Report and follow through: issue the reports, agree remediation with leadership, and reassess against the baseline.

## Demo and pricing

Pricing is quoted on request, based on the size of the team and the number of organizations being assessed. Book a live demo or request pricing at https://ciso.aero/demo; the form asks for name, work email, company and organization type, and the team replies by email.
